facts.why: The plot summaries and reviews I opened do not name the restaurant where Charlie and Paulie work. It is described only as a high end Village restaurant.
facts.fix: Keep only if the restaurant name is confirmed in the film; otherwise rename.

facts.text: Bleecker Street, New Year's Eve. This block has always blown its own horn.
facts.why: No source I opened puts the film on New Year's Eve or on Bleecker Street.
facts.fix: Greenwich Village, a Friday night. This block has always blown its own horn.

facts.text: for a day at the track with Paulie's racehorse
facts.why: Paulie bets on a horse. A review says he puts everything on it to win, but nothing says he owns it. Charlie is the one who collects $20,000.
facts.fix: for a day at the track with Paulie's can't-lose horse

vibe.verdict: A smart captain's book that uses the staff and the cops well, but it skips the safe job and the lye in the coffee.
